finding: EU customs guidance lists drones as possible personal effects for temporary admission. A traveller resident outside the EU customs territory may qualify for import-duty relief if the item is reasonably required for the journey and the temporary admission conditions are met. Some drones are classified as means of transport, which changes the procedure. Ask customs at the point of EU entry how to declare the drone and document re-export.
jurisdiction_scope: Hungary under the EU customs territory; temporary admission for qualifying nonresident travellers.
authority: European Commission, Special Procedures Guidance, Annex VII item 22; Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/2446 Article 219
open_questions: Confirm model classification and local declaration practice. Aviation permissions, batteries and permanent imports are separate. Territorial scope: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2013/952/oj/eng/pdf Article 4.

finding: Use marked hiking trails or educational paths in strictly protected areas. Entry away from those routes generally needs authorization from the nature conservation authority. Ordinary protected areas generally allow entry on foot without a permit, subject to local restrictions.
jurisdiction_scope: Hungarian protected and strictly protected natural areas.
authority: Hungarian State Nature Conservation

finding: In designated Hortobágy demonstration areas, private nature photography is generally allowed without approval if it does not unduly disturb wildlife. For off-trail nature photography, concealed setups near wildlife, or nonprivate filming, contact the park directorate for prior approval.
jurisdiction_scope: Land managed by the Hortobágy National Park Directorate.
authority: Hortobágy National Park Directorate, Visitor Rules Annex 2

finding: Budapest public transport may refuse carriage to passengers under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Check the operator’s conduct conditions before boarding.
jurisdiction_scope: Budapest BKK-operated or integrated public transport subject to its travel conditions.
authority: Budapest Transport Centre

finding: Book a permitted landing boat operator to visit Sceilg Mhichíl. Check with the operator for the season, weather-related cancellations and landing conditions before travelling to the departure point.
jurisdiction_scope: Sceilg Mhichíl landing access, County Kerry, Republic of Ireland.
authority: Office of Public Works, Heritage Ireland

finding: Do not dig, excavate or use metal detection to uncover archaeological features or objects without the appropriate Ministerial licence or consent. For a specific monument or activity, ask the National Monuments Service before proceeding.
jurisdiction_scope: Republic of Ireland, archaeological searches and works under the National Monuments Acts.
authority: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage, National Monuments Service

finding: Possession of controlled drugs generally needs legal authority, such as an applicable medicines or prescription exception. Verify the exact substance and the authority to possess it before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Republic of Ireland, controlled-drug possession under Misuse of Drugs Act, section 3 and current regulations.
authority: Irish Statute Book, Misuse of Drugs Act

finding: Dublin City has bye-laws restricting drinking intoxicating liquor on roads and in public places. Check the city rules and use licensed venues where permitted.
jurisdiction_scope: Dublin City Council area; locally regulated public drinking.
authority: Dublin City Council

finding: Photography and filming are forbidden in specified Prague Castle exhibitions and galleries. Other historic interiors may need a photography licence. Check the exact location and restrictions before using a camera.
jurisdiction_scope: Prague Castle historic buildings, galleries and exhibitions; venue rules.
authority: Prague Castle Administration

finding: Report a chance archaeological find to the Institute of Archaeology or nearest museum, directly or through the municipality, by the second day after finding it or becoming aware of it. Leave the find and site undisturbed pending examination.
jurisdiction_scope: Czechia, chance archaeological finds outside authorized research.
authority: Czech Ministry of Culture, State Heritage Preservation Act section 23

finding: Avoid disrupting guided visits with loud speech or amplified sound at Prague Castle, and follow directions from site staff. Visitors visibly under the influence of alcohol or other intoxicants can be refused entry.
jurisdiction_scope: Prague Castle complex; site visitor regulations.
authority: Prague Castle Administration, Visitor Regulations Articles 5 and 7

finding: Check the Czech telecommunications regulator’s general authorization for PMR446 before packing or using a walkie-talkie. Its permission is subject to equipment and frequency conditions.
jurisdiction_scope: Czechia, operation of PMR446 radio equipment; this does not establish customs treatment.
authority: Czech Telecommunication Office, VO-R/3/6.2016-9

finding: The City of Brussels prohibits drinking alcohol in public spaces inside its mapped central zone around the clock through 6 October 2030. Licensed terraces and city-authorized or city-organized events are exceptions. Check the map for the location.
jurisdiction_scope: Designated City of Brussels central zone, Belgium.
authority: City of Brussels

finding: Belgian justice guidance treats cannabis possession as an offence. A lower prosecution priority can apply in narrowly defined adult cases; this is not a permission to possess or consume in public.
jurisdiction_scope: Belgium; federal cannabis possession and prosecution policy.
authority: Belgian Federal Public Service Justice

finding: Organized television or film recording in public space in the City of Brussels is covered by the city’s event application procedure. Contact the city in advance if planning a production; enquire separately about ordinary tourist photos if a site has its own rules.
jurisdiction_scope: City of Brussels public spaces in postal codes 1000, 1020, 1120 and 1130; organized TV or film recordings.
authority: City of Brussels

finding: Check reserve maps and posted notices before entering Swedish bird and seal protection areas. Entry can be restricted when birds are nesting or seals are raising pups.
jurisdiction_scope: Swedish protected areas; restrictions apply to individually designated sites and periods.
authority: Swedish Environmental Protection Agency

finding: Sweden’s Armed Forces state that filming or photographing their protected objects from the air is a criminal offence. Check official restrictions before aerial photography.
jurisdiction_scope: Protected objects of the Swedish Armed Forces; aerial imaging.
authority: Swedish Armed Forces

finding: Do not disturb, excavate or damage a protected ancient monument in Sweden. Ask the County Administrative Board before taking any action that could alter one.
jurisdiction_scope: Swedish ancient monuments protected under Chapter 2 of the Historic Environment Act.
authority: Swedish National Heritage Board, Historic Environment Act chapter 2, sections 6 and 12

finding: Swedish Police describe unauthorized possession of narcotics as an offence. Keep the prescription for legally prescribed controlled medicine accessible and check separately what documents you need to cross the border.
jurisdiction_scope: Sweden, possession of narcotics or controlled medicine during a stay.
authority: Swedish Police Authority

finding: Ask the Danish Nature Agency for permission before equipment-assisted tree climbing in its forests. Its visitor guidance distinguishes ordinary tree climbing from climbing using special aids.
jurisdiction_scope: Danish state forests managed by Naturstyrelsen.
authority: Danish Nature Agency

finding: The Museum of Danish Resistance allows group visitors to take handheld or phone photos without flash. Ask staff about special equipment or restrictions in a particular exhibition.
jurisdiction_scope: Museum of Danish Resistance, Copenhagen; group visit rules.
authority: National Museum of Denmark, Museum of Danish Resistance

finding: Copenhagen Police maintain mapped nightlife zones where people subject to specified court bans can be barred during nighttime hours. Police extended the designated zones through 31 May 2027; check their current notice and the precise terms of any applicable order.
jurisdiction_scope: Designated Copenhagen nightlife zones and people subject to a relevant individual ban.
authority: Copenhagen Police

finding: Obtain the relevant permission before organizing an event or using a snowmobile in a state-owned protected area. Fishing and hunting also have separate permit systems. Check the location’s own rules before relying on general access.
jurisdiction_scope: Finnish state-owned protected areas managed by Metsähallitus, including national parks.
authority: Metsähallitus Parks & Wildlife Finland

finding: Avoid interfering with protected ancient monuments in Finland without prior authorization. The Finnish Heritage Agency handles applications for permits to interfere with monuments.
jurisdiction_scope: Finland, fixed ancient monuments protected by the Antiquities Act.
authority: Finnish Heritage Agency, Antiquities Act section 11

finding: Traficom lists compliant analog PMR446 equipment in the 446.000–446.200 MHz band as exempt from radio licensing. Check technical conditions if bringing another model or frequency setting.
jurisdiction_scope: Finland, domestic radio use; customs treatment is a separate question.
authority: Traficom, Radio Frequency Regulation allocation table

finding: If you accidentally uncover a suspected archaeological item, stop the activity immediately and report the discovery promptly to the heritage authority through the municipal clerk. Keep the site and item undisturbed pending instructions.
jurisdiction_scope: Hungary, chance discoveries outside archaeological excavations.
authority: Hungarian National Legislation Database, Act LXIV of 2001 section 24

finding: At the Finnish Heritage Agency collections service, take personal note-taking photos without flash and without disturbing other users. Seek separate permission before publication; special equipment restrictions also apply.
jurisdiction_scope: Finnish Heritage Agency collections service; on-site note-taking photos.
authority: Finnish Heritage Agency, Permit and Collection Service

finding: Foreign visitors arriving at one of five pilot airports can use the voluntary Pre-arrival Information (PAI) form at prearrival.immigration.gov.vn and save the generated QR code for the immigration checkpoint.
jurisdiction_scope: Voluntary pilot at Tan Son Nhat, Noi Bai, Da Nang, Cam Ranh and Phu Quoc international airports.
authority: Embassy of Viet Nam in Bangladesh, 30 September 2026 notice
open_questions: Recheck airport coverage or a change from voluntary to mandatory before release or travel.

finding: Declare narcotic, psychotropic or precursor medicines at customs and carry the prescription. The embassy identifies a licence-free personal-treatment limit of up to seven days for narcotic medicines or ten days for psychotropic or precursor medicines, subject to the prescribed dose. Ask the entry-port customs authority before taking a larger supply.
jurisdiction_scope: Inbound personal treatment quantities for medicines classified in Viet Nam in those groups.
authority: Embassy of Viet Nam in Australia, Bring medication into Viet Nam
open_questions: Confirm the medicine and active ingredient classification, the required label and prescription details, and whether a greater quantity can be approved.

finding: Declare items subject to plant quarantine in hand or checked baggage and present them for inspection. Customs clearance for those items follows completion of import quarantine formalities.
jurisdiction_scope: Inbound plant-quarantine items carried in passenger baggage.
authority: Viet Nam Official Gazette, consolidated Law on Plant Protection and Quarantine, Article 29(3)–(4)
open_questions: Confirm the regulated object list, any required certificate or permit and the authorized port. Animal products require a separate check.

finding: Leave e-cigarettes and heated tobacco products out of baggage. Viet Nam lists both types as prohibited imports and exports under its foreign trade decree effective 5 September 2026.
jurisdiction_scope: National import and export restriction on electronic cigarettes and heated tobacco products.
authority: Ha Tinh Department of Health, citing Decree 292/2026/ND-CP Appendix I
open_questions: Confirm any narrowly defined exceptions with Viet Nam Customs before release.

finding: The Ministry of Health identifies a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate requirement for travellers coming from affected countries. If your itinerary includes an affected country, ask port health or your carrier to confirm documentation for your route before departure.
jurisdiction_scope: Affected-country travel history. Separately evidenced health condition from the general All Indonesia arrival declaration.
authority: Indonesia Ministry of Health, Emerging Infections Yellow Fever FAQ
open_questions: Confirm current country list, age and transit exceptions, and applicable lookback from port health.

finding: Check the excise allowance before bringing in e-liquid. Indonesian customs lists up to 30 mL of open-system liquid or up to 12 mL of closed-system liquid in adult passenger baggage, with proportional limits when combining tobacco products.
jurisdiction_scope: Passenger-baggage excise allowance for travellers aged 18 and over.
authority: Indonesia Directorate General of Customs and Excise, excise exemption facilities
open_questions: Confirm classification, combined categories and current handling of any excess before travel.

finding: Do not pack electronic cigarettes for travel into India. The national Act prohibits importing electronic cigarettes and covered devices, including certain products with or without nicotine.
jurisdiction_scope: National import ban on devices under the statutory definition.
authority: India Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, notice on compliance with the Prohibition of Electronic Cigarettes Act, 2019
open_questions: Check the statutory definition and the treatment of any medicinal product approved under the separate drugs framework.

finding: Check site rules before using a tripod, filming or flying a drone at Archaeological Survey of India monuments. ASI requires prior written permission for those activities.
jurisdiction_scope: ASI protected monuments and sites.
authority: Archaeological Survey of India, Dos and Don’ts at protected monuments
open_questions: Still photography and site-specific restrictions differ. Confirm permissions directly with the site.

finding: A traveller importing covered communications equipment for personal use can qualify for a conformity-assessment exemption for one unit per model. Check the equipment category with the National Radio Research Agency if bringing multiple units or unusual radio equipment.
jurisdiction_scope: Conformity assessment of covered personal-use broadcasting and communications equipment, not customs valuation. The FAQ illustrates smartphones and tablets.
authority: Republic of Korea National Radio Research Agency, Conformity Assessment FAQ, citing Radio Waves Act Enforcement Decree Annex 6-2
open_questions: The FAQ does not establish how a particular drone or its controller is classified. Confirm separate customs and equipment rules.

finding: Bring a reusable bag when shopping in New South Wales. Businesses cannot supply covered lightweight handled plastic shopping bags of 35 microns or less, subject to exceptions.
jurisdiction_scope: NSW supply rule with exclusions including certain barrier bags. It concerns retail supply.
authority: New South Wales Environment Protection Authority, plastics bans FAQ
open_questions: Other states and territories have different rules. This source does not establish an inbound luggage prohibition.

finding: Follow signs and maps at Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park. Parks Australia asks visitors not to photograph or film designated sites sacred to Anangu Traditional Owners.
jurisdiction_scope: Specific culturally sensitive sites within Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park.
authority: Parks Australia, information about film and photography at Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park
open_questions: Check park guidance for site boundaries and separate commercial filming or photography permissions.

finding: Check the personal-use quantities and declaration instructions before packing vape products. The Bureau of Customs passenger guide lists two atomizer sets, 200 mL of e-juice and 100 g of atomizer parts or accessories.
jurisdiction_scope: Arriving passengers, personal-use limits in the Customs guide.
authority: Philippines Bureau of Customs, Travel With Ease passenger guide
open_questions: Confirm the current rules for disposable or restricted products and whether the arrival port requires declaring the goods.

finding: A bona fide tourist or similar transient holding a valid home-country licence may drive during the first 90 days of their stay, subject to licence conditions. For a longer stay, check Philippine licence requirements.
jurisdiction_scope: Temporary foreign-licence use under the Land Transportation Office implementing rules.
authority: Philippines Land Transportation Office, Revised IRR of RA 10930, Section 9.5.3
open_questions: Check translation needs, insurance and rental terms before travelling.

finding: If driving in Singapore on a foreign licence for a stay under 12 months, check whether to carry an International Driving Permit or an official English translation. The Singapore Police Force exempts drivers with a valid licence from an ASEAN member state from the IDP requirement.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreigners staying under 12 months, subject to licence validity and the listed ASEAN provision.
authority: Singapore Police Force, Singapore Driving Licence
open_questions: Verify rental conditions and special rules for permanent residents or work-pass holders.

finding: Leave native plants and animals in place at Bukit Timah and Central Catchment nature reserves. NParks lists removal of native flora and fauna among activities that are prohibited there.
jurisdiction_scope: Bukit Timah and Central Catchment Nature Reserves.
authority: Singapore National Parks Board, Bukit Timah and Central Catchment Nature Reserve guide
open_questions: Check specific park rules and any research permit arrangements with NParks.

finding: Visitor Visa applicants must meet health requirements and may be asked for a chest X-ray or medical examination. For stays over six months, Immigration New Zealand requires a chest X-ray for applicants meeting its tuberculosis-country citizenship or residence-history tests, subject to applicable exemptions.
jurisdiction_scope: New Zealand Visitor Visa applications. Requirement depends on length of stay, country and travel history.
authority: Immigration New Zealand, Visitor Visa health requirements
open_questions: Check the current TB country list, exemptions, prior X-rays and whether you are applying under a different visa route.

finding: Carry a reusable bag when shopping. New Zealand restricts retailer supply of specified single-use plastic shopping and fresh-produce bags, including covered compostable plastic produce bags.
jurisdiction_scope: New Zealand retail supply restrictions and defined product categories.
authority: New Zealand Ministry for the Environment, single-use and hard-to-recycle plastic bans
open_questions: Review bag-type exclusions. This source does not establish a general traveller baggage ban.

finding: Foreign air passengers can complete the Sri Lankan arrival card online starting three days before travel through the Immigration and Emigration e-services website.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreign arrivals by air, online arrival card facility.
authority: Airport and Aviation Services Sri Lanka, online arrival card notice
open_questions: Check the current portal and whether a paper card remains available at your arrival point.

finding: Sri Lanka asks travellers aged nine months or older arriving after visits or qualifying transit in yellow-fever-risk countries to present a valid vaccination certificate. Confirm the exact transit rule and certificate timing with Sri Lanka Port Health before departure.
jurisdiction_scope: Route-dependent yellow fever requirement, ages nine months and over.
authority: Sri Lanka Ministry of Health Quarantine Unit, yellow fever FAQ
open_questions: The same Ministry FAQ gives inconsistent 6-day and 10-day wording and ambiguous 12-hour transit phrasing. Do not publish an exact threshold until Port Health confirms it.

finding: Check the Sri Lanka Customs exemptions for tourists before packing. The published exemption lists personal clothing and essentials, two regular bottles of wine and up to 1.5 litres of spirits. Commercial quantities and goods brought for resale fall outside the tourist personal-effects definition.
jurisdiction_scope: Incoming non-resident tourists under Sri Lanka Customs passenger classifications.
authority: Sri Lanka Customs, Travellers guide, Tourist Baggage Exemptions
open_questions: Check any additional product restrictions, declaration procedure and allowances for your specific goods.

finding: Visitors intending to fly a drone should request flight approval through the Civil Aviation Authority’s online portal. Check the planned location against its drone-zone map, submit the required details, and wait for approval before flying.
jurisdiction_scope: Sri Lanka visitor drone flight approval, subject to drone, activity and zone.
authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka, Drone Approvals
open_questions: Confirm approvals and temporary flight restrictions for the date and exact location. Import permissions are a separate step.

finding: Carry a valid passport for tourist admission unless your nationality qualifies for an accepted identity card or travel document. Migraciones lists Brazil, Bolivia, Uruguay, Paraguay, Chile, Peru, Venezuela, Ecuador and Colombia for that alternative.
jurisdiction_scope: Argentina tourist admission, nationality-specific document options.
authority: Dirección Nacional de Migraciones
open_questions: Check the separate visa rule and the exact identity document accepted for your nationality and route.

finding: Check with Migraciones before departure whether the sworn entry declaration is in use at your crossing. DNU 366/2025 provides for a declaration of the purpose of entry and health insurance, with enforceability tied to implementation regulations.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreigners seeking admission to Argentina under covered migration categories.
authority: Poder Ejecutivo Nacional, DNU 366/2025, articles 9 and 33
open_questions: Locate the implementing regulation and confirm the current form, start date, insurance details and operational rollout before publishing as required.

finding: The Ministry of Health epidemiological bulletin states that Argentina does not require a yellow-fever vaccination certificate for national entry. Check current guidance for your itinerary and vaccination advice for areas of risk.
jurisdiction_scope: Argentina national entry position recorded in the cited bulletin, specific to yellow fever.
authority: Ministerio de Salud de la Nación, national epidemiological bulletin 640
open_questions: Confirm current policy before promotion. This source addresses yellow fever certification only, not insurance or other health measures.

finding: If ANMAT authorization is needed to import a medicine, its foreign-applicant procedure uses Trámites a Distancia and asks for a valid foreign identity document and prescription or supporting treatment records.
jurisdiction_scope: ANMAT authorization pathway for foreign applicants importing medicine.
authority: ANMAT, 2000-IE003-00 instructions for foreign applicants
open_questions: Ask ANMAT and customs whether this pathway applies to the specific medicine, quantity and accompanied baggage. The cited instructions do not establish a blanket tourist permit requirement.

finding: Submit the inbound baggage declaration when goods exceed the applicable allowance and duty is due, or when carrying goods regulated by SENASA. ARCA offers a digital declaration or the applicable manual OM-2087 form.
jurisdiction_scope: Argentina accompanied baggage on entry.
authority: Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero
open_questions: Check the route-specific allowance and quantity limits. Use separate currency rules for cash or instruments.

finding: Brazilian entry officials may ask for evidence of transportation out of Brazil and funds compatible with the purpose and length of the trip. Keep proof readily available.
jurisdiction_scope: Brazil entry inspection, discretionary request.
authority: Presidência da República, Decree 9.199/2017 article 170
open_questions: Check valid travel document, visa or authorization requirements separately for the passport and itinerary.

finding: Brazilian Federal Police publishes an entry/exit card and instructions for presenting it with a passport or equivalent and keeping the duplicate when the card process is used. Ask the carrier or border post whether you need a form.
jurisdiction_scope: Published entry/exit card procedure, crossing and traveler applicability unverified.
authority: Polícia Federal
open_questions: Verify which crossings and traveler categories still use the paper form before advising all travelers to print it.

finding: Brazil’s Ministry of Health says vaccination proof is not required for entry, and recommends keeping vaccinations current before travel, including considering yellow-fever vaccination in line with health guidance.
jurisdiction_scope: International travelers entering Brazil under the ministry’s published vaccination guidance.
authority: Ministério da Saúde
open_questions: Check risk and vaccine advice for destinations within Brazil and documentation required by onward countries.

finding: Use the electronic traveler goods declaration and the Goods to Declare channel when carrying declarable goods, such as goods above the applicable allowance or goods subject to special controls. If there is no channel, present the declaration to customs.
jurisdiction_scope: Brazil inbound passenger customs declaration.
authority: Receita Federal
open_questions: Check product restrictions and value and quantity limits for the actual route and baggage.

finding: The Ministry of Health says international entry is not restricted for yellow fever under its guidance. It recommends vaccination at least 10 days before entering risk municipalities and says vaccination history is requested at entry to or exit from very-high-risk municipalities.
jurisdiction_scope: Yellow fever national arrival guidance and local movement in designated municipalities.
authority: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social, yellow fever FAQ question 9
open_questions: Verify the current risk map, circulars, local exceptions and carrier instructions for the itinerary.

finding: Prepare Form 530 when Colombian customs requires a traveler declaration, including covered non-personal goods above the applicable allowance or goods subject to product-specific controls.
jurisdiction_scope: Travelers including nonresident tourists at Colombian customs.
authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
open_questions: Review amount, quantity, traveler status and whether a specific item qualifies for passenger import.

finding: Before packing animal products, ask ICA whether the specific product and origin qualify for the accompanied-baggage list under Andean Community Decision 737. Origin-based health restrictions can still apply.
jurisdiction_scope: Colombia inbound accompanied animal products under the ICA traveler FAQ.
authority: Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario, citing Andean Community Decision 737 article 36
open_questions: Verify current product and quantity limits, source-country restrictions and declaration or inspection procedure. Plant items require separate checking.

finding: DIAN says drones cannot enter under the normal traveler import procedure. At Bogotá El Dorado airport or ports within Cartagena’s customs jurisdiction, customs can consider a change of import procedure if the drone is presented. Confirm approval and documentation before packing it.
jurisdiction_scope: Colombian customs treatment of drones, including the restricted points for consideration of a change of procedure.
authority: DIAN, Concepts 7383 and 3540 of 2026 interpreting Resolution 242/2025
open_questions: Check current DIAN rules, exact port and documentation. The interpretation separately addresses registered equipment re-entering after documented temporary export.

finding: Costa Rica’s health ministry says foreign travelers who have been in designated yellow-fever risk areas within the prior six days must present the international vaccination certificate on arrival.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreign arrivals after recent presence in areas designated by Costa Rica’s health ministry.
authority: Ministerio de Salud
open_questions: Check the current risk-area list, transit treatment, vaccine timing and applicable exemptions with the ministry and airline.

finding: Costa Rican customs distinguishes personal luggage from other carried goods. A tax exemption of up to 500 Central American pesos in customs value can apply to non-baggage goods if the traveler meets the absence and reuse conditions, including 72 hours abroad and six months between uses.
jurisdiction_scope: Costa Rica accompanied goods, conditions on the non-baggage exemption.
authority: Servicio Nacional de Aduanas, 2026 decision citing General Customs Law articles 114–115 and CAUCA IV articles 113–114
open_questions: Confirm the classification and customs value of your goods and declaration procedure for your crossing.

finding: Declare carried cash and covered securities when entering or leaving Costa Rica at US$10,000 or more, or its equivalent in another currency. Complete the customs declaration when the threshold is met.
jurisdiction_scope: Costa Rican and foreign travelers entering or leaving Costa Rica.
authority: Sistema Costarricense de Información Jurídica, regulation implementing Law 8204 article 35
open_questions: Check treatment of particular instruments and declaration procedure at the port.

finding: On Avianca-operated flights, keep no more than two power banks in the cabin, each no more than 100 Wh. Protect terminals, keep the banks out of checked baggage and overhead bins, and follow crew instructions.
jurisdiction_scope: Avianca-operated flights only, including Avianca services on a Costa Rica itinerary.
authority: Avianca, published passenger baggage policy
open_questions: Check each operating carrier, including connections. Costa Rica DGAC has a separate update, but its linked document details were not retrieved.

finding: Peru’s migration guidance says the virtual Andean Migration Card is generated at entry through its control service. Check and download the record to verify the stay granted after admission.
jurisdiction_scope: Peruvian entry migration processing with automatic TAM Virtual.
authority: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones
open_questions: Check the exact port workflow. The general TAM guidance distinguishes forms at some land border posts.

finding: Peru’s health authority recommends vaccination at least 10 days before visiting rural risk areas of the Peruvian Amazon and notes some endemic rural access points may ask for a certificate.
jurisdiction_scope: Itinerary-specific health advice and possible rural entry-point checks, within Peru.
authority: Ministerio de Salud, CDC Perú traveler yellow fever guidance
open_questions: Verify the specific site, route, age and contraindication guidance. This is not evidence of a general national entry condition.

finding: A published MTC resolution states an exemption from the telecommunications import permit for one listed private-use drone per trip or shipment when included in a customs declaration. Confirm the current treatment of your model and tariff classification before travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Peru, private-use equipment in specified tariff lines, including the baggage regime where applicable.
authority: Ministerio de Transportes y Comunicaciones, resolution amending R.D. 163-2016-MTC/27, article 2
open_questions: Confirm whether the older resolution and listed tariff classifications still apply to your device. Check customs declarations, duties and flying rules separately.

finding: For Egypt tourist e-Visa entry, carry a printed e-Visa and a passport valid for at least six months from arrival, plus the itinerary and accommodation details requested by the portal.
jurisdiction_scope: Egypt e-Visa tourist route; eligibility depends on nationality and other published conditions.
authority: Egypt Ministry of Interior, Electronic Visa Portal FAQ
open_questions: Check passport eligibility and whether another entry route applies. The portal instructs applicants to apply at least seven days before departure.

finding: If Egyptian Customs requires a passenger arrival declaration (Customs Form 45), provide the passport details, country of embarkation, arrival date and description of carried articles, especially gold or precious metals.
jurisdiction_scope: Egyptian customs inspections of arriving passengers; covers the customs declaration rather than a general immigration landing card.
authority: Egypt Customs Authority, Instruction 37/2023
open_questions: Confirm when the declaration is required and whether the destination terminal has implemented the announced digital landing card change.

finding: Travelers aged nine months or older arriving from a yellow-fever-risk country, including qualifying airport transit over twelve hours, should confirm applicability and carry an international yellow-fever vaccination certificate.
jurisdiction_scope: Egypt point-of-entry health rule for an applicable origin or transit; not a routine requirement for every origin.
authority: EgyptAir point-of-entry notice; WHO International Travel and Health country list corroboration
open_questions: Confirm the current list for origin and transit and any medical exception before travel. WHO corroboration: https://www.who.int/docs/default-source/travel-and-health/countries-with-risk-of-yellow-fever-transmission.pdf

finding: Check with the Egyptian authorities before carrying a medication that may be controlled, including some prescribed and over-the-counter products. UK travel advice recommends carrying a doctor’s letter listing the condition, medicine and quantity.
jurisdiction_scope: Personal medicines brought into Egypt; letter guidance from UK government travel advice.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm exact active ingredient, controlled schedule, permits and permitted quantity with the Egyptian authorities. A doctor’s letter alone does not establish clearance.

finding: Cairo International Airport advises arriving travelers not to bring seeds or agricultural seedlings and states that quarantine may destroy them. Check approval for any regulated plant material before packing.
jurisdiction_scope: Airport passenger guidance for international arrivals at Cairo; narrower than a nationwide list of all food or plant restrictions.
authority: Cairo International Airport passenger Customs Regulations
open_questions: Confirm any prior approvals or exceptions with Egypt Customs or plant quarantine, and check separately for food. Qatar’s embassy independently relays Egyptian foreign-ministry restrictions on specified seeds and seedlings: https://cairo.embassy.qa/en/egypt/travel-tips.

finding: EgyptAir specifies one power bank in a personal bag in the cabin and prohibits using it to charge devices or recharging it during the flight.
jurisdiction_scope: EgyptAir-operated flights; operator policy, not an Egyptian border requirement.
authority: EgyptAir restricted-items page
open_questions: The source labels the capacity limit in watts. Confirm the applicable watt-hour limit and any listed model restrictions with the operating airline before packing.

finding: Check whether your nationality or status requires Jordanian prior approval. Jordan’s Ministry of Interior describes an electronic visit-visa process for those requiring approval and instructs travelers to print the approval before travel. Its manual requests a passport or valid travel document valid for at least six months.
jurisdiction_scope: Jordan Ministry of Interior electronic visit-visa route requiring prior approval.
authority: Jordan Ministry of Interior e-services manual
open_questions: Check passport-specific eligibility and any change to the published process or documentation.

finding: If using Jordan’s qualifying foreign-residency exception to prior approval, bring your return ticket and evidence of eligible residency valid for at least six months.
jurisdiction_scope: Only the arrival-visa route described in the Ministry of Interior FAQ for travelers relying on eligible foreign residency.
authority: Jordan Ministry of Interior FAQ
open_questions: Check the current list of eligible residence countries, nationality limitations and any additional conditions before relying on this exception.

finding: If staying in Jordan for more than 30 days, confirm with Jordanian authorities whether HIV testing and a health certificate apply to your status. UK travel advice lists testing for stays beyond 30 days.
jurisdiction_scope: Health screening for longer stays; UK government advice, not a universal requirement for short-stay visitors.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm precise traveler categories and process with the Jordanian Ministry of Health or consulate before publication.

finding: Jordan’s Food and Drug Administration says patients importing an unregistered medicine for their own treatment under the named-patient route may bring up to three months’ supply with a prescription and a medical report.
jurisdiction_scope: Named-patient, non-commercial import of unregistered pharmaceutical products into Jordan.
authority: Jordan Food and Drug Administration
open_questions: Confirm the exact product, special controls for narcotic or psychotropic ingredients, any approval and traveler procedure with JFDA.

finding: Declare goods that may be subject to taxes or duties or may be prohibited. Jordan Customs lists penalties for undeclared non-exempt personal items and gifts, including lower-value items.
jurisdiction_scope: Passenger customs when entering or leaving Jordan; neither a blanket duty exemption nor an import authorization.
authority: Jordan Customs Trade Repository, penalties for import/export violations
open_questions: Check the applicable personal allowance, declaration requirements and restrictions by item. UK guidance corroborates declaration of potentially prohibited or dutiable goods.

finding: Check with Jordan’s plant quarantine authority before bringing covered plants or plant products. Article 3 of the national plant quarantine instructions includes covered materials accompanying passengers.
jurisdiction_scope: Jordan import, export and transit of plants or plant products covered by specific phytosanitary decisions.
authority: Jordan Ministry of Agriculture, Plant Quarantine Instructions No. 12 of 2021, Article 3, via IPPC
open_questions: Confirm the exact commodity, origin, phytosanitary certificate and any personal-use exception. Arabic text of Article 3 also indexed at https://www.jolaws.com/t/lob-5-291/تعليمات-الحجر-النباتي-رقم-12-لسنة-2021/m/3.

finding: Declare cash and bearer negotiable instruments exceeding JOD 10,000 or its equivalent to Jordan Customs when entering or leaving Jordan.
jurisdiction_scope: Persons crossing the Jordanian border with cash or bearer negotiable instruments.
authority: Jordan Customs, implementation announcement for AML/CFT Law No. 20 of 2021
open_questions: Verify current aggregation, conversion and declaration instructions before travel.

finding: Jordan Aviation lists power banks as permitted in hand baggage and prohibited in hold baggage.
jurisdiction_scope: Jordan Aviation-operated flights only; carrier policy.
authority: Jordan Aviation hand-luggage restrictions
open_questions: Check current capacity, quantity and onboard-use limits with the operating carrier.

finding: Obtain the required Jordanian approvals before operating a drone. The CARC operations form calls for the mission location and timing and identifies a minimum filing lead time of ten working days for this route.
jurisdiction_scope: Jordan drone operations covered by CARC Form 25-0010; staged separately from permission to import a drone.
authority: Jordan Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission, Drone Operations Approval Application Form
open_questions: Confirm which registration and authorization process applies to the current operation, plus location restrictions and security coordination.

finding: Bring a valid recognized passport or travel document and check whether your nationality needs a visa or an electronic travel authorization. Eligible applicants can use the official Acces Maroc portal.
jurisdiction_scope: Foreign arrivals to Morocco; visa or AEVM applicability is passport- and status-specific.
authority: Moroccan National Tourist Office; Law No. 02-03 Article 3
open_questions: Confirm passport-validity rules for the specific passport and itinerary. Published UK advice has a distinct passport-validity statement for British citizen passports.

finding: UK government travel advice says travelers coming from a polio-affected country must show proof of polio vaccination. Confirm whether your itinerary is covered and carry the applicable certificate.
jurisdiction_scope: Morocco inbound health requirement tied to affected origin; government advisory sources.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
open_questions: Confirm current affected countries, whether transit is included, acceptable certificate and any exception with Moroccan authorities before publication.

finding: Declare items potentially prohibited or subject to customs taxes or duties when entering or leaving Morocco.
jurisdiction_scope: Passenger customs; goods and duty rules depend on the article.
authority: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office; refers to Moroccan ADII customs guidance
open_questions: Check the exact item and current exemptions with Moroccan Customs. The linked Moroccan Customs passenger page returned a request rejection during review.

finding: Morocco’s food safety authority reported a passenger restriction on bringing plants, ornamental plants and seeds. Check the plant item with ONSSA and leave it unpacked unless current authorization is confirmed.
jurisdiction_scope: Passenger-carried plant material entering Morocco, as described in a June 2022 announcement reproduced in the ONSSA phytosanitary bulletin.
authority: Moroccan National Office of Food Safety, phytosanitary watch bulletin
open_questions: Confirm the current legal basis and whether any subsequent changes or personal-use exceptions apply. Do not extend this evidence to all food or plant products.

finding: Check the Qatar Tourism visa wizard for your ordinary passport before departure. The passport-specific options include visa-free entry and Hayya electronic applications.
jurisdiction_scope: Qatar tourist travel with an ordinary passport. Route and supporting documents vary by nationality and traveler status.
authority: Qatar Tourism, Visit Qatar visa guidance
open_questions: Confirm the exact authorized route and passport-validity terms. Government pages do not uniformly state the same validity period.

finding: Qatar’s Ministry of Interior lists a return or onward ticket for its on-arrival visa route. It also lists hotel, cash or credit-card evidence for some nationalities.
jurisdiction_scope: Qatar Ministry of Interior on-arrival visa guidance. This is route-specific supporting evidence, not a universal arrival card.
authority: Qatar Ministry of Interior, General Directorate of Passports, Visa Conditions
open_questions: Verify the current requirements for the passport, residence and visa route through the visa wizard or MOI.

finding: For a planned Qatar stay over 30 days, Visit Qatar instructs travelers to obtain visitor health insurance from a provider registered with the Ministry of Public Health.
jurisdiction_scope: Longer visitor stays in Qatar. Separate visa routes or extensions may have their own insurance terms.
authority: Qatar Tourism, Visit Qatar health insurance guidance
open_questions: Confirm timing, current registered providers and any route-specific condition with the authority.

finding: When entering Qatar from outside the GCC with regulated plant material, declare it to customs. Qatar’s agricultural quarantine law allows a possible phytosanitary-certificate exemption for accompanied plants or plant products not intended for cultivation or reproduction.
jurisdiction_scope: Regulated material arriving from outside the GCC; the possible traveler exemption addresses certification only.
authority: Qatar Legal Portal, Law No. 24 of 2005 Concerning Agricultural Quarantine, Articles 2–4
open_questions: Confirm protections for the exact item, the exemption, any permit or inspection, and whether newer rules apply before travel.

finding: For goods brought into Switzerland for private use or as gifts, check the CHF 150 VAT-free threshold per person per day. If the taxable total exceeds it, VAT applies to the full value. Separately check quantity allowances and use QuickZoll or declare to customs when applicable.
jurisdiction_scope: Switzerland; private cross-border goods. Personal effects temporarily used and re-exported qualify separately.
authority: Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security
open_questions: Check eligible aggregation and any restricted goods that require direct processing.

finding: Switzerland does not require a routine cash declaration. Answer customs questions truthfully. At CHF 10,000 or more, or if officers suspect that amount is carried, be prepared to explain your identity, the source and intended use, and who owns the funds.
jurisdiction_scope: Swiss incoming, outgoing and transit border checks; cash, foreign currencies and bearer instruments.
authority: Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security
open_questions: Check every other jurisdiction on the route separately.

finding: If bringing a drone temporarily to Switzerland as filming or photography production equipment covered by Directive 10-60, arrange temporary customs clearance through an ATA Carnet or the Swiss temporary admission declaration (ZAVV).
jurisdiction_scope: Switzerland; temporary entry of covered photo/film production equipment including drones, under the overseas-use heading.
authority: Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security Directive 10-60 §3.11.2.1 B.16
open_questions: Confirm the correct procedure with FOCBS for a personal recreational drone, ownership/rental arrangements, and project details. Flight permission is separate.

finding: For eligible travelers aged 17 or older, Swiss customs lists duty-free alternatives that include up to 250 mL of nicotine-containing e-liquid or 25 disposable e-cigarettes per person per day. Check the full table for cartridges, tobacco and combinations, and declare excess.
jurisdiction_scope: Swiss border; traveler allowances by product and quantity.
authority: Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security
open_questions: Check VAT and restrictions separately.

finding: Before crossing a Swiss border with an animal- or plant-derived souvenir, check its species and documentation. Protected specimens, including found as well as purchased articles, may be prohibited or require permits. Defined souvenir exemptions have quantity and other conditions.
jurisdiction_scope: Switzerland; animal/plant souvenirs carried across borders.
authority: Swiss Federal Food Safety and Veterinary Office
open_questions: Verify with the FSVO and origin/destination authorities for the specimen and route.

finding: Use the official entry check before taking a dog, cat or ferret to Switzerland. Conditions depend on its origin and route, and private travel with an owned pet is treated separately from import for transfer to someone else.
jurisdiction_scope: Switzerland; companion dogs, cats and ferrets.
authority: Swiss Federal Food Safety and Veterinary Office
open_questions: Use the authority’s result for the specific origin, animal and route.

finding: South Africa requires an online traveller declaration for entry or departure from 1 July 2026. File no more than 24 hours before departure, using the last leg directly to South Africa for an inbound connecting journey. Air or sea passengers staying in the designated transit area are excluded. If you cannot file in advance, ask customs for help at the port.
jurisdiction_scope: South African air, land, sea and rail ports; traveler declarations.
authority: South African Revenue Service
open_questions: Check limited paper procedures, and use the red channel when required for dutiable, restricted or temporary goods.

finding: Check the separate South African traveler duty-free quantities for wine, other alcohol and tobacco before packing them. Age and eligibility rules apply, and excess quantities must be declared.
jurisdiction_scope: South African customs; accompanied alcohol and tobacco.
authority: South African Revenue Service
open_questions: Check product-specific rules for vaping or nicotine products separately.

finding: If taking valuable goods out of South Africa temporarily and bringing them back, ask customs to record them before departure and retain the proof for re-entry. Declare controlled goods and confirm permits separately.
jurisdiction_scope: South African departure; temporary export of goods for reimport.
authority: South African Revenue Service
open_questions: Confirm the procedure for the particular item, ownership and trip.

finding: Before taking protected wildlife products across a South African border, check the species and whether an import or export permit is required. CITES can cover tourist curios, exotic leather, wood and derivatives as well as live specimens.
jurisdiction_scope: South Africa; international movement of CITES-listed species and derivatives.
authority: South African Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
open_questions: Confirm species appendix, origin and documents with the designated permit authority.

finding: A nonresident tourist has no set value limit for eligible belongings temporarily brought into Norway for use and taken out again. Goods left behind, such as gifts or consumables, are subject to a NOK 6,000 value limit for tourists. Check separate alcohol, tobacco and food quotas and declare excess.
jurisdiction_scope: Norway; nonresident tourist baggage and goods left in Norway.
authority: Norwegian Customs
open_questions: Resident and short-return-trip thresholds differ. Check product-specific controls.

finding: Declare currency and covered payment instruments valued at more than NOK 25,000 when entering or leaving Norway. File the customs form at the relevant customs office, using the red channel on arrival.
jurisdiction_scope: Norway; entry and departure; notes, coins and other covered means of payment.
authority: Norwegian Customs
open_questions: Check current currency conversion and the form instructions.

finding: Before taking nicotine vapes or nicotine liquid into Norway, check the medicinal smoking-cessation exception. Norwegian Customs lists nicotine-containing vapes and e-liquid without medical proof of smoking cessation among prohibited items.
jurisdiction_scope: Norway; accompanied traveler imports, distinct from online orders and on-site use.
authority: Norwegian Customs
open_questions: Confirm your product and documentation before traveling.

finding: Check for a special permit before bringing covered protected plants, animals or derivatives into or out of Norway. The authority describes limited exceptions for certain items brought back by Norwegian residents.
jurisdiction_scope: Norway; border movement of protected species and products.
authority: Norwegian Customs
open_questions: Ask the Norwegian Environment Agency about the item and route.

finding: A valid licence from most non-EU/EEA countries can normally be used for three months after arrival in Norway, subject to licence and age requirements. Some licences also need an international driving permit.
jurisdiction_scope: Norway; temporary visitors holding most non-EU/EEA licences.
authority: Norwegian Public Roads Administration
open_questions: Check the special rules for UK, Swiss, Japanese and Ukrainian licences, residence, IDP needs and licensing classes.

finding: Declare items brought for someone else, business merchandise, regulated goods and repairs or alterations to goods returned to Kenya. Used personal effects may qualify for relief. Ask customs to confirm the threshold before relying on a duty-free allowance for newly purchased goods.
jurisdiction_scope: Kenya passenger terminal clearance; accompanied baggage.
authority: Kenya Revenue Authority
open_questions: KRA materials distinguish the newer USD 2,000 personal/household concession from a returning-passenger declaration question that still cites USD 500. Confirm item valuation, exemption eligibility, and the actual declaration threshold; no threshold claimed here.

finding: Before bringing regulated plants or plant products to Kenya, arrange the Plant Import Permit and exporting-country phytosanitary certificate required for covered plant consignments. Declare the plant material to an inspector at entry.
jurisdiction_scope: Kenya; plant material subject to KEPHIS import controls.
authority: Kenya Plant Health Inspectorate Service
open_questions: Ask KEPHIS whether your specific food or product and passenger-baggage quantity are covered and which port can process it.

finding: Declare covered monetary instruments worth USD 10,000 or more, or equivalent, to a customs officer before taking them into or out of Kenya.
jurisdiction_scope: Kenya; entry and departure with monetary instruments.
authority: Kenya Financial Reporting Centre; POCAMLA §12
open_questions: Confirm accepted forms, type of instrument and valuation method.

finding: Check with Kenya Wildlife Service before moving an item made from a listed species across the border. Covered imports, exports and transit are prohibited or require permits under the specified species rules.
jurisdiction_scope: Kenya; movement of listed protected species or covered specimens through Kenya.
authority: Kenya Wildlife Service; Wildlife Conservation and Management Act endangered-species regulations
open_questions: Confirm which appendix, exception and permit apply to the specimen.

finding: On arrival in Iceland, proactively declare and present dutiable or restricted goods to customs and use the red channel. If uncertain whether your goods qualify for duty-free entry or are restricted, use the red channel.
jurisdiction_scope: Iceland; accompanied goods at arrival.
authority: Iceland Revenue and Customs
open_questions: Confirm current product allowances and prohibitions separately.

finding: Check personal food restrictions before traveling. Iceland generally prohibits meat and dairy from outside the EU/EEA subject to defined exceptions. Used riding equipment and riding gloves are prohibited, and used fishing gear must be disinfected before use in Icelandic rivers and lakes.
jurisdiction_scope: Iceland; traveler food and used riding/fishing equipment.
authority: Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority
open_questions: Check product-specific exceptions and arrange the required proof of disinfection for fishing gear.

finding: Declare €10,000 or more in cash or covered bearer instruments, including traveler’s cheques, on entry to or departure from Iceland. Use the official reference rate if carrying other currencies.
jurisdiction_scope: Iceland; accompanied monetary instruments on arrival and departure.
authority: Iceland Customs Act No. 88/2005, Article 27a
open_questions: The consolidated Icelandic legal text sets the inclusive threshold. Some English customs material still says above €10,000; ask Iceland Customs for the applicable form.

finding: Arrange an Icelandic import permit before bringing a dog or cat. Check the animal’s approved country category, veterinary requirements and quarantine booking before booking travel.
jurisdiction_scope: Iceland; incoming dogs and cats, veterinary admission and quarantine.
authority: Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority
open_questions: Use the latest country-category and pet-specific instructions for certificates and approved shipment dates.

finding: Iceland Customs lists a personal tobacco allowance of 200 cigarettes or 250 g of other tobacco. Use its separate alcohol combinations and declare excess. The listed minimum age is 20 for alcohol and 18 for tobacco.
jurisdiction_scope: Iceland; traveler alcohol and tobacco duty-free allowances.
authority: Iceland Revenue and Customs
open_questions: Check vape and nicotine products separately.
